Normally  the patient have to undergo the therapy for  three weeks, others may take some more time. Everybody have to continue the medication (internal and external) for at least 6 months to one year depends on the age, severity of the problem etc. If the age is above 60 or the problems is severe and suffering for years, in such cases we advice the patients to continue the herbal paste bandage for at least six months.   What is Osteoarthritis (Knee pain)?

Osteoarthritis (Knee pain) is a joint inflammation that results from cartilage degeneration. It is a group of mechanical abnormalities involving degradation of joints including articular cartilage and subchondral bone. Cartilage is a protein substance that serves as a “cushion” between the bones of the joints. Symptoms may include joint pain or a burning sensation in the associated muscles and tendons, tenderness, stiffness, locking,  and sometimes an effusion.   It cause a cracking sound when the affected joint is moved, especially while climbing the steps.  Some times there may be muscle spasm and  contractions in the tendons.  Occasionally the joint may be filled with fluid. When bone surfaces become less well protected by cartilage, bone may be exposed and damaged. Osteoarthritis may affect the hands, feet, spine, hips and knees.  The affected joints become larger, stiff and painful.
